title: System acceleration calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly calculate the acceleration of the combined system using a = F/(m_A + m_B).

title: Correct force application
description: Important: Student must apply Newton's second law to object B alone to find the contact force (F_N = m_B * a).

title: Final numerical answer
description: Essential: Student must obtain the correct elastic force magnitude of 6 N.

title: Free-body diagram reasoning
description: Important: Student should correctly identify forces on each object, showing the contact force as the only horizontal force on B.

title: Units and direction
description: Optional: Student includes proper units (N) and may specify the force direction between objects.

title: Incorrect system isolation
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly applies F = m_A * a to find contact force or confuses which mass to use.

title: Sign or calculation error
description: Pitfall: Student makes arithmetic mistakes in acceleration (16/8 = 2 m/s²) or final force (3×2 = 6 N).
